Prepare step by step

  1. Follow responder and official emergency instructions; call 911 for immediate danger.
  2. Do not enter an unsafe building or drive an unsafe vehicle.
  3. Record observable conditions and preserve photos, reports, receipts and dates shown by the original source under your control.
  4. Separate emergency, utility, repair, insurance, assistance and legal questions.

This plan does not replace emergency instructions, inspection, insurance, repair, medical or legal decisions.
